paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
coupling_convention: DM-electron scattering reference cross section sigma_bar_e in cm^2 for F_DM = 1 (heavy mediator), exactly as plotted on the y-axis; NOT a dimensionless g_ae
notes: DarkSide-50 sets new 90% C.L. observed exclusion limits on the axioelectric coupling g_Ae for galactic ALP dark matter absorbed by argon electrons, with newly excluded parameter space strongest for masses 0.03-0.2 keV (30-200 eV); the assumed local DM density is 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (Standard Halo Model, v_esc=544 km/s, v_0=238 km/s). However, all numerical limit values appear only in Fig. 2 (a plot), with no table or explicit coupling numbers in the text, so no reliable (mass, g_Ae) pairs could be extracted. The paper also constrains dark photon kinetic mixing kappa, DM-electron cross section sigma_e, and sterile neutrino mixing |Ue4|^2; AxionElectron chosen per the g_Ae result and pre-analysis hint. Traced the solid red DarkSide-50 (2022) observed 90% C.L. limit. Minimum ~7e-40 cm^2 near 140-160 MeV/c^2; steep threshold rise below ~16 MeV/c^2, consistent with the paper's quoted best-limit range 16-56 MeV/c^2. Masses converted MeV -> eV (x1e6).
